A contrast-enhancing mass lesion approximately 38x36 mm is present in the upper mediastinum adjacent to the trachea and the right subclavian artery. A mass lesion approximately 98x57 mm in size is observed in the apical and posterior segments of the right upper lobe, with solid components in the medial section, opening into the trachea and the right main bronchus, and containing cavities. Indistinctly defined ground-glass opacities are observed in the surrounding lung parenchyma. Focal fluid increases and fibrotic bands are noted in the pleural surface of the right upper lobe. Nodular and, in places, tree-like infiltrations are observed in the medial and lower lobe segments of the right middle lobe. Hyperdense appearances consistent with mucus impaction filling the bronchial lumen and peripheral nodular infiltrations were observed in the basal segments of the lower lobe of the right lung (bronchopneumonia?, aspiration pneumonia?). Bilateral peribronchial thickenings are present. Degenerative changes are observed in the bone structures.

Tarifli nodüler infiltrasyonlara yer yer fokal bronşektatik değişiklikler de eşlik etmektedir. Her iki akciğerde peribronkovasküler kalınlaşmalar dikkati çekmiştir. Hastanın kliniği ve serolojisi ile birlikte değerlendirilmesi önerilir. Sağ akciğer alt lobda 16 mm çapında hafif kalın duvarlı pnömokist dikkati çekti. Sağ hemitoraksta 20 mm, sol hemitoraksta 3 mm kalınlığa ulaşan efüzyon ve efüzyon komşuluklarında kompresif atelektaziler dikkati çekti. Kesitler dahilinde; Batında tüm recesslerde yaygın sıvı dikkati çekmiştir. Kemik yapılarda yoğun dejeneratif değişiklikler izlenmiştir.

Changes and suture materials related to sternatomy were observed in the sternum. Widespread atheroma plaque calcifications are present in the aorta and coronary artery tracts. Widespread osteophytic degenerative changes were observed at the corners of the vertebral bodies. As far as the cross-section was concerned, a slightly dilated appearance of up to 36 mm in the abdominal aorta was noted. Widespread calcified plaques were observed in the abdominal aortic wall. Since the examination was performed without contrast, a detailed evaluation could not be made.

ACİL PULMONER BT ANJİYOGRAFİ İNCELEMESİ KLİNİK BİLGİ:DİSEKSYİYON? TEKNİK: Acil şartlarda intravenöz kontrast madde enjeksiyonu sonrasında 1 mm kalınlığında kesitler elde edilmiş ve MPR görüntüler üzerinden 3 planda değerlendirme yapılmıştır. Tetkik için 100 ml noniyonik kontrast madde kullanılmıştır. BULGULAR: Trakea ve her iki ana bronş normal genişliktedir. Çekim PTE açısından uygun fazda elde olunamamıştır. Bu nedenle inceleme suboptimaldir. Değerlendirilebildiği kadarıyla; pulmoner konus, ana pulmoner arterler ve değerlendirilebilen proksimal dallarında belirgin trombüs saptanmamıştır.Segment arter dalları çekim fazının uygun olmaması nedeniyle optimal değerlendirilememiştir. Kalp boyutları normal sınırlardadır. Mediastende ve her iki hilusta patolojik boyutta lenf nodu saptanmadı. Akciğer parankim alanlarında aktif infiltrasyon izlenmedi.Sağ akciğer orta lob lateral segmentte 4 mm çapında buzlu cam opasitesinde parankimal nodül izlendi. Her iki hemitoraksta plevral sıvı saptanmadı.

EMERGENCY PULMONARY CT ANGIOGRAPHY EXAMINATION CLINICAL INFORMATION: DISSECTION? TECHNIQUE: In emergency conditions, 1 mm thick sections were obtained after intravenous contrast agent injection, and evaluation was performed in 3 planes from MPR images. 100 ml of nonionic contrast agent was used for the examination. FINDINGS: The trachea and both main bronchi are of normal width. The imaging was not obtained in the appropriate phase for PTE. Therefore, the examination is suboptimal. To the extent that could be evaluated; no significant thrombus was detected in the pulmonary conus, main pulmonary arteries, and their evaluable proximal branches. Segmental artery branches could not be optimally evaluated due to the inappropriate imaging phase. Heart dimensions are within normal limits. No pathologically enlarged lymph nodes were detected in the mediastinum or both hilum. No active infiltration was observed in the lung parenchyma. A 4 mm diameter parenchymal nodule with ground-glass opacity was observed in the lateral segment of the right lung's middle lobe. No pleural fluid was detected in either hemithorax.

EMERGENCY PULMONER IT ANGIOGRAPHY STUDY CLINICAL INFORMATION: DISEXISION? TEKNİK: In emergency conditions, 1 mm thick cross sections were obtained after intravenous contrast substance injection and 3 plans were evaluated via MPR images. 100 ml of nonionic contrast agent was used for the study. FINDS: Trachea and both major bronchi are of normal width. The attraction was not achieved in the appropriate phase in terms of PTE. Therefore, the review is suboptimal. As far as it can be assessed, no significant thrombus has been detected in the pulmonary subject, main pulmonary arteries, and proximal branches that can be assessed.The segment artery branches have not been optimally evaluated due to the lack of proper gravity phase. Heart sizes are within normal limits. No lymph nodes of pathological size were detected in mediastende and both hilus. Active infiltration was not monitored in the lung parenchyma areas. Paranchymal nodule was monitored in a 4 mm diameter icy glass opacity in the right lung central lobe lateral segment. No pleural fluid was detected in both hemitors.

TECHNIQUE: In emergency conditions, 1 mm thick sections were obtained after intravenous contrast agent injection, and evaluation was performed in 3 planes using MPR images. 100 ml of nonionic contrast agent was used for the examination. FINDINGS: The patient's other thoracic pathologies were described in the previous thoracic CT scan performed on the same day, and the current examination was performed solely for pulmonary thromboembolism. ACİL TORAKS BT TEKNİK: Acil şartlarda intravenöz kontrast madde enjeksiyonu yapılmadan, 1.3 mm kalınlığında kesitler elde olunmuştur. BULGULAR: Bilateral akciğer parankiminde kontüzyon/laserasyon bulgusu izlenmedi. Her iki hemitoraksta hemo/pnömotoraks izlenmedi. L1 vertebra sağ transvers prosesinde fraktür mevcuttur. Sol 6. kosta arkında eski fraktür ve kal dokusu, 5. kosta arkında hafif düzensizlik; sol klavikula lateralinde eski deplase fraktür dikkati çekmiştir. Sağ hemitoraks orta kesimde kostalarda yer yer eski fraktürler ve kallus formasyonu izlenmektedir. Sağ 12. kosta posteriorunda kostovertebral ekleme yakın nondeplase, 11. kosta posteriorunda deplase, 10. kosta posterolateralinde deplase fraktürler izlenmektedir. Hastanın tekrarlayan travma etiyolojisi açısından araştırılması önerilir.

EN-genel · Google19 eşleşme

EMERGENCY THORACIC CT TECHNIQUE: 1.3 mm thick sections were obtained under emergency conditions without intravenous contrast agent injection. FINDINGS: No contusion/laceration was observed in the bilateral lung parenchyma. No hemo/pneumothorax was observed in either hemithorax. A fracture is present in the right transverse process of the L1 vertebra. An old fracture and callus tissue are noted in the left 6th costal arch, slight irregularity in the 5th costal arch; and an old displaced fracture in the lateral aspect of the left clavicle. In the middle section of the right hemithorax, scattered old fractures and callus formation are observed in the ribs. Non-displaced fracture near the costovertebral joint in the posterior aspect of the right 12th rib, displaced fracture in the posterior aspect of the 11th rib, and displaced fracture in the posterolateral aspect of the 10th rib are observed. Further investigation for recurrent trauma etiology is recommended.

EN-ucuz · Opus-MT11 eşleşme

EMERGENCY TORAKS BT TEKNİK: In emergency conditions, sections of 1.3 mm thickness were obtained without intravenous contrast substance injection. RESULTS: No signs of contusion/laseration were observed in bilateral pulmonary parenchyma. Hemo/pneumothorax was not monitored in both hemithoraxes. L1 vertebra fracture is present in the right transverse process. In the left 6th costa arc, the old fracture and kal tissue, slight irregularity in the 5th costa arc; in the left clavicula lateral, the old deplase fracture attracted attention. The right hemithorax is located in the midsection in the costas, followed by old fractures and callus formation. The costovertebral addition in the right 12th kosta posterior is closely followed by nondeplase, deplase in the 11th kosta posterior, deplase fractures in the 10th kosta posterolateral. It is recommended that the patient be investigated in terms of recurrent trauma etiology.

ACİL KONTRASTSIZ TORAKS BT TETKİKİ TEKNİK: Acil şartlarda intravenöz kontrast madde verilmeden 2 mm kalınlığında kesitler alınmıştır. BULGULAR: IVKM verilmediğinden kalp boşlukları, mediastinal vasküler yapılar ve lenf nodları açısından değerlendirme optimal yapılamamıştır. Trakea lümeni içerisinde entübasyon kanülü izlenmektedir. Koroner arter traselerinde aort ve dallarında kalsifik plaklar izlendi. Torakal aort tortiyoze görünümdedir. Mediastende patolojik boyuta ulaşmayan kalsifik-nonkalsifik lenf nodları dikkat çekmiştir. Kalp boyutları normaldir. Perikardiyal efüzyon saptanmadı. Trakea ve her iki ana bronş açıktır. Sol ana bronş içerisinde lümeni oblitere etmeyen sekresyon materyalleri izlendi. Her iki akciğerde tüm loblarda alt loblarda daha belirgin olmak üzere plevral yüzlerde fibrotik yapılanmalar ve retiküler dansite artımları mevcuttur. Sağ akciğer alt lobda lineer bant tarzında atelektaziler izlendi. Alt loblarda daha belirgin septal kalınlaşmalar mevcuttur. Sol akciğer alt lobda subsegmenter atelektazi ile uyumlu görünümler mevcuttur. Akciğer parankim alanlarında aktif infiltrasyon bulgusu izlenmemiştir. Her iki hemitoraksta plevral sıvı saptanmadı. Kemik yapılarda dejeneratif değişiklikler izlenmiştir. Torakal vertebralarda açıklığı sola bakan belirgin skolyoz izlendi. Kesit dahilinde abdomende; sol sürrenal bezde nodüler kalınlaşma mevcuttur. Elektif şartlarda kontrastlı MRG ile değerlendirilmesi önerilir (adenom?).

EN-genel · Google46 eşleşme

EMERGENCY NON-CONTRAST THORACIC CT EXAMINATION TECHNIQUE: 2 mm thick sections were obtained under emergency conditions without intravenous contrast administration. FINDINGS: Due to the lack of IV contrast, optimal evaluation of the heart chambers, mediastinal vascular structures, and lymph nodes could not be performed. An endotracheal cannula is visible in the tracheal lumen. Calcified plaques were observed in the coronary artery tracts, aorta, and branches. The thoracic aorta has a tortuous appearance. Calcified and non-calcified lymph nodes in the mediastinum, not reaching pathological size, were noted. Heart dimensions are normal. No pericardial effusion was detected. The trachea and both main bronchi are open. Secretory material that did not obliterate the lumen was observed in the left main bronchus. Fibrotic structures and increased reticular density are present in all lobes of both lungs, more prominent in the lower lobes, on the pleural surfaces. Linear band-like atelectasis was observed in the lower lobe of the right lung. More pronounced septal thickening is present in the lower lobes. Appearance consistent with subsegmental atelectasis is present in the lower lobe of the left lung. No active infiltration was observed in the lung parenchyma. No pleural fluid was detected in either hemithorax. Degenerative changes were observed in the bone structures. Significant scoliosis with the opening facing to the left was observed in the thoracic vertebrae. Within the section of the abdomen, nodular thickening is present in the left adrenal gland. EMERGENCY NON-CONTRAST THORACIC CT SCANNING CLINICAL INFORMATION: Right-sided CT scan shows pneumothorax + pneumothorax size? TECHNIQUE: 2 mm thick sections were obtained under emergency conditions without intravenous contrast administration. FINDINGS: Due to the lack of IV contrast, optimal evaluation of the heart chambers, mediastinal vascular structures, and lymph nodes could not be performed. Heart dimensions are normal. No pericardial effusion was detected. Calcified plaques are present in the coronary artery tracts, aorta, and branches. The trachea and both main bronchi are open. An increased number of lymph nodes (LAP) were noted in the mediastinum, the largest measuring 24x19 mm in the right upper paratracheal region. No active infiltration was observed in the lung parenchyma. A 36 mm deep pneumothorax was observed in the right hemithorax, adjacent to the medial segment of the middle lobe. In the right lung, hypodense lesions with soft tissue density were observed at the peribronchovascular level, measuring 40x30 mm, and in the superior segment of the lower lobe, measuring 45x30 mm, with a pleural base and fine fibrotic retraction towards the center (primary lung cancer?). Evaluation of the patient along with their past investigations is recommended. Irregular reticulations consistent with subsegmental atelectasis were observed in the posterobasal segments of the lower lobes of both lungs. A solid nodular lesion causing a pathological fracture was observed in the lateral section of the right 7th rib (metastasis? primary cancer?). Widespread degenerative changes are present in the bone structures. In the abdomen, including the section, a hypodense nodular appearance with a diameter of 38 mm was observed in the middle section of the left kidney (cyst?).
